title: Smallest witnesses by girth for rad(n) | f(n)
description: Smallest members of S(f) = {n : rad(n) | f(n)} by the girth of their covering digraph, for f = sigma, sigma* and phi*. Eighteen values, all proved minimal by a cutoff lemma that bounds the largest prime a smaller witness could use; four of them had not been computed before. Verified by independent implementations and cross-checked against Pollack and Pomerance (2012).
